[Permanent] If your Leader is "Frieza" and your non-"Frieza" Battle Card would be removed from a Battle Area by an opponent's skill, you may switch this card in a Battle Area to Rest Mode instead.

[On Play] Draw 1 card.

660103.Description:
[On Play] Place 1 card from your hand on top of its owner's deck : Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 3 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it.

[When Attacking] Place the top 4 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop.

660104.Description: [On Play] If your Leader is "King Piccolo" and you don't have an energy marker, you place 1 energy marker. Then, add up to 1 card from your life to your hand and play up to 1 "Demon's Egg" from your hand or Drop.

660105.Description:
[Permanent] This card can't attack.

[Activate Main] Place 1 Battle Card from your Battle Area into its owner's Drop : Place the top 3 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop. Then, negate the skills of this card in a Battle Area for the turn.

660108.Description: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, then reveal up to 1 "Gotenks" or Extra and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

660109.Description: [On Play] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, then reveal up to 1 card with a cost of 5 or less and "Android" in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

660111.Description: [Activate Battle] If you have 20 or more cards in your Drop, your cards that are in a battle get +15000 power for the battle.
